# GPT-OSS short CUDA parity fixture

This fixture pins a short, raw-text tokenizer and numerical comparison contract
for the opt-in `scripts/gpt-oss/run-short-parity.ps1` runner.

The committed JSON is metadata only. The 1,206,604-byte llama.cpp `_logits_`
binary remains an external input and must match the recorded SHA-256 before the
runner reads it. The reference was generated by llama.cpp b11026 with
`llama-perplexity`; it contains three compressed rows for the first eight token
IDs. Those rows compare to one Candle prefill result followed by two cached
decode steps.

The tokenizer policy is explicitly `add_bos=false`, `add_eos=false`, and the
full token sequence is pinned in `reference.json`. No chat template, prompt
rewrite, forced prefix, or model download is part of this fixture.
